reader.reads: Read Bergson’s French Le Rire in the 1900 Alcan edition against the register readings, using the Wikisource transcription and the Internet Archive scan.

title.en: Laughter: An Essay on the Meaning of the Comic

thesis.ru: Комического нет за пределами собственно человеческого.
thesis.en: There is no comic outside what is properly human.

conceptions.note: This sentence grounds the human scope; the sibling conceptions address laughter and correction.
conceptions.negation: Il n’y a pas de comique en dehors de ce qui est proprement humain.

thesis.ru: Смех обычно сопровождается бесчувственностью; естественная среда комического — безразличие.
thesis.en: Laughter is ordinarily accompanied by insensibility; indifference is the natural medium of the comic.

thesis.ru: Механическое, наложенное на живое, — центральный образ, от которого воображение расходится в разные стороны.
thesis.en: The mechanical encrusted on the living is a central image from which imagination radiates in divergent directions.

conceptions.note: The central image itself names the mechanical on the living; rigidity and its relation to the comic appear in the sibling conception grounded at p. 50.

thesis.ru: Комическое выражает несовершенство, требующее немедленного исправления; смех есть это исправление и общественный жест, который подчёркивает и подавляет особую рассеянность людей и событий.
thesis.en: The comic expresses an imperfection calling for immediate correction; laughter is that correction and a social gesture that marks and represses a particular absent-mindedness of people and events.

conceptions.note: The definition of the comic and its mechanical rigidity are stated separately in the sibling conception.

thesis.ru: Комическая сцена получается, когда положение переворачивается и роли меняются местами.
thesis.en: A comic scene results when a situation is reversed and the roles are exchanged.

thesis.ru: Ситуация всегда комична, когда она одновременно принадлежит двум совершенно независимым рядам событий и допускает истолкование одновременно в двух совершенно различных смыслах.
thesis.en: A situation is always comic when it belongs at once to two absolutely independent series of events and can be interpreted at once in two entirely different senses.

thesis.ru: Игра слов всегда выдаёт мгновенное отвлечение языка и потому забавляет.
thesis.en: Wordplay always reveals a momentary distraction of language and is amusing for that reason.

conceptions.note: The sentence treats wordplay; related conceptions cite the author on wit and parody. The register’s literal and figurative collision is not asserted here.

thesis.ru: Смех исправляет негибкость гибкостью, вновь приспосабливает каждого ко всем и подавляет сепаратистские стремления.
thesis.en: Laughter corrects rigidity into flexibility, readapts each person to all, and represses separatist tendencies.

conceptions.note: This passage states the social correction of rigidity; the comic is addressed in the sibling conception.

thesis.ru: Комическое — сторона человека, которой он похож на вещь, и сторона человеческих событий, чья особая негибкость подражает механизму, автоматизму и движению без жизни.
thesis.en: The comic is the side of a person that resembles a thing and the aspect of human events whose particular rigidity imitates mechanism, automatism and movement without life.

conceptions.note: The distinct correction of the imperfection is stated in the sibling conception.

thesis.ru: В рассмотренном ряду эффектов, начинающемся с идеи искусственной механизации человеческого тела, комическое происходит от того, что живое тело закостеневает в машину.
thesis.en: In the series of effects considered, beginning with the idea of an artificial mechanization of the human body, the comic comes from the living body stiffening into a machine.

conceptions.note: The summary on p. 50 identifies the series beginning with artificial mechanization of the human body; the passage that follows states where the comic came from in this case.

thesis.ru: Пародия возникает при переводе торжественного в фамильный тон.
thesis.en: Parody arises from transposing the solemn into a familiar tone.

conceptions.note: The sentence specifies parody by transposition; the other aspects of the register reading are addressed separately.

thesis.ru: Инверсия и интерференция — игры ума, приводящие к играм слов.
thesis.en: Inversion and interference are plays of wit that lead to wordplay.

conceptions.note: The passage relates wit and wordplay through inversion and interference.

verb.ru: служит исходным пунктом объяснения застывания тела в машину как
verb.en: is the starting point for the account of the stiffening body as

links.note: The summary identifies the series beginning with artificial mechanization of the human body; the following passage names the mechanical on the living as the starting point and asks where the comic came from in this case.
The page describes correction rather than an unconditional causal claim.

The place calls a situation comic when it belongs at once to two absolutely independent series and can be interpreted in two entirely different senses; it does not state that interference produces the situation.

left.reason: The research comparison claims that wordplay creates incongruity; the sentence on wordplay instead describes momentary distraction of language and does not state this relation.
